Do you experience sharp pain specifically when you lift your arm to the side between 60 and 120 degrees, and is there tenderness when I press on the front of your shoulder joint? We have now ruled out major rotator cuff tears, adhesive capsulitis, cervical radiculopathy, and subacromial bursitis, leaving a differential of occult labral pathology, calcific tendinitis, or referred pain from the brachial plexus.
